topic: Designing Useful Products from Recyclable Materials
key_concepts: Waste generated daily can exceed landfill capacity
Uncollected waste causes land, water, and air pollution
The 5Rs are Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, Repair, and Recover
Reduce means lessening the amount of possible waste materials
Reuse means using materials again for the same purpose
Recycle means processing waste materials into another product
Repair means fixing broken items so they can be used again
Recover means taking energy or materials from wastes to convert into new resources
Recycling reduces waste sent to landfills and conserves natural resources
Recycling prevents pollution by reducing the need to collect new materials
Waste management promotes a clean and healthy environment and zero waste
Designing useful products from local recyclable solid or liquid materials applies the 5Rs
